params.prompt: A candid morning frame from a phone video in a small American apartment bedroom. She is the same 23-year-old white American woman in every shot: honey light-brown shoulder-length hair, small gold stud earrings, light natural brows, natural unretouched skin with only faint fine lines at the outer eye corners, and an oversized heather-grey crewneck sweatshirt with no lettering, logo or print anywhere on it. Her hair is twisted up in a loose, slipping claw clip with messy flyaways from sleep; nothing falls over her forehead. She has just pushed herself up on her forearm on the frame-left side from a crumpled white pillow and turns her face to the lens, head upright, groggy, eyes half open, lips closed. Deep red pillow-crease lines are pressed into her skin: three or four long diagonal creases run across the cheek on the frame-right side of the image (her left cheek), from near the ear to beside the nose, and two more run up across her forehead; they are red, slightly raised and cast tiny shadows. Bright morning daylight comes through white window blinds behind her on the frame-right side and rakes across her face from the side, so every crease shows clearly. Her free hand rests on the pillow below her chin on the frame-right side. Her boyfriend holds the phone: he lies beside her, and the soft, out-of-focus edge of his stubbled jaw and cheek (short dark hair, light stubble, never his full face) fills a narrow strip along the frame-left edge in the foreground. White duvet, a white light-switch plate and the edge of a wooden nightstand in the background. Her face sits in the middle third of the frame and is at least a third of the frame width. Hands in frame: only her two hands, five fingers each. Keep the top fifth of the frame plain background (wall, blinds or fairy lights) with nothing important in it. Shot on a phone held by her boyfriend: casual vertical handheld phone footage, slightly imperfect framing, natural indoor light, a little phone-camera grain; not a studio, film or ad look. Photorealistic smartphone photo, unretouched, no beauty filter, visible pores and natural skin texture, sharp focus on her face. Her hair is pulled fully back off her forehead. The skin is dry and matte with no cream or lotion. No mirror in the shot. No text, captions, logos or watermark.
